452.title: ArtofTomworks · LTX 2.5 Simple [GLOBAL]
452.body:
Image-to-video using your established LTX 2.5 pipeline. Two-stage generation with latent spatial upscaling, audio and live preview.

The model and VAEs are already present on this machine. LoRAs start OFF. ArtofTomworks appears only in the workflow, never on the video.

608 × 1088 · 4 s · 24 FPS

453.title: LIVE STATUS · CPU / GPU / VRAM
453.body: The lower-right monitor shows elapsed time, a sampling-stage ETA, and CPU, GPU, VRAM and RAM load. Crystools supplies hardware readings. ETA excludes decoding and saving.

454.title: PREVIEW · TIME · ETA
454.body: Model Preview Override shows partial frames during generation. The preview does not represent final video quality. If missing, check KJNodes and refresh the ComfyUI page.

455.title: QUICK START · OUTPUT
455.body:
1. Replace the first frame and enter your scene prompt.
2. Set duration, FPS and output size.
3. Optionally enable an LTX-compatible LoRA.
4. Run the graph. Find the result in SaveVideo and ComfyUI output/video.

The second sampling pass and latent upscaler add spatial detail; they do not increase FPS.

457.title: LANGUAGE SELECTION
457.body: Select HU, EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT or PL. Labels and the monitor change together; generation settings do not.

458.title: REQUIREMENTS AND HELP
458.body:
Required: LTX 2.5 FP8 model, Gemma text encoder, LTX 2.5 video/audio VAEs, LTX latent 2× upscaler. Extensions: rgthree Power LoRA, KJNodes preview, Crystools, ArtofTomworks monitor. Pro retains the existing graph's optional interpolation element, disabled by default.

rgthree: https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy
